name: claude-design-local
description: Local equivalent of Anthropic's Claude Design research preview. Ships a pluggable design-system folder, a generic prototype starter, and skills + slash commands for both using existing systems and authoring new ones — so teams can iterate themed prototypes in Claude Code without weekly credit caps and without being locked into a single brand.

templates.name: prototype-starter
templates.description: Generic HTML/Tailwind prototype starter. Combined with any design system under design-systems/ via scripts/new-prototype.sh.

designSystems.description: Folder containing all shipped design systems. Each subfolder is one system (slug = folder name) and must satisfy the contract in design-systems/README.md.
